messages:
marcus (Design): posted a compact history variant for the version timeline. aim = dense rows for teams with long version histories. mock: https://img.redwood.local/history-compact-v2.png :mag:
marcus (Design): Qs: 1) do we show small diff indicators inline or open diffs in a right drawer? 2) in compact mode should we collapse rollbacks into a single marker or keep them as separate nodes?
elaine (PM): keep compact but show a tiny diff icon inline when there's a meaningful change (>2% model perf delta). full diffs in drawer. collapse rollbacks visually but allow expand to see exact rollback time.
devin (Eng): compact rendering is fine but performance caveat: avoid attaching heavy hover listeners to every node. delegate events. also use CSS masks for the tiny icons rather than multiple img assets.
nora (A11y): compact is fine if keyboard focus order is preserved. propose focusable nodes with aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen summary: "v4.8 — rolled out 2026-02-12 — 15% traffic — latency p95 (5m): 420ms". for collapsed rollbacks include a control "expand rollbacks" that is keyboard operable.
elaine (PM): copy guidelines for drawer header when showing diffs: title "Changes for v4.8" then subtitle "Compared to v4.7 — decreased latency p95 by 8% — increased mem usage by 3%". keep short bullets.
devin (Eng): UX -> when user applies a historic traffic % via scrubber, we should surface an "apply" CTA that is explicit e.g. "Apply 12% traffic to v4.8" and a small undo toast: "Traffic changed to 12% — undo (5m)". backend note: log prior state for audit.
ops-bot: history snapshot created by deploy pipeline at 1923456789
marcus (Design): a11y + perf asks noted. i'll update mock: add aria-describedby, compact diff icon via CSS mask, and the collapsed rollback affordance. will also wire explicit apply CTA copy per devin.
elaine (PM): agree on the undo toast. make undo window configurable per org. add an enterprise toggle to disable auto-undo for compliance customers.
devin (Eng): i'll implement delegated event listeners and measure CPU during a 500-node timeline. will report in #eng-runtime.
nora (A11y): will test keyboard flow + screen reader with the new mock. prefer verbose aria-describedby for history items but concise toast copy.
marcus (Design): thanks all — i'll post updated assets tomorrow and add notes about performance tradeoffs in the mock annotations. Closing thread.
